tests.title: Signup creates a new user account with valid credentials
tests.description: Verifies that registering with a valid unique email and an 8+ character password creates the account and navigates to the dashboard.

steps.action: Fill Email with a unique valid email address and Password with 'Passw0rd!23'

steps.expected: Lands the user on the dashboard URL (/dashboard)

tests.title: Signup rejects an invalid email address
tests.description: Verifies that providing an invalid email without standard domain structure displays the required error message.

steps.action: Fill Email with 'not-an-email' and Password with 'Passw0rd!23'

tests.title: Signup rejects passwords shorter than 8 characters
tests.description: Verifies password length requirement enforcement during user registration.

steps.action: Fill Email with a unique valid email and Password with 'Pass7!'

steps.expected: Password must be at least 8 characters

tests.title: Login succeeds with valid seeded credentials
tests.description: Verifies that logging in with the correct email and password navigates to the dashboard.

steps.action: Fill Email and Password with valid seeded tester credentials

steps.expected: Lands the user on the dashboard (/dashboard)

tests.title: Login with an invalid password displays error message
tests.description: Verifies that incorrect password credentials show an error alert and keep the user on the login page.

steps.action: Fill Email with valid tester email and Password with 'WrongPass123!'

tests.title: Login handles email address casing insensitively
tests.description: Verifies that uppercase letters in the email address authenticate successfully without failure.

steps.action: Fill Email with 'QA.Tester@Example.com' and Password with valid password

steps.expected: Lands the user on the dashboard (/dashboard)

tests.title: Dashboard adds and displays a new task item
tests.description: Verifies creating a new item with a valid title displays that item on the dashboard list.

steps.action: Fill Item title with 'Buy groceries' and submit
steps.expected: Shows 'Buy groceries' in the item list

tests.title: Dashboard rejects adding an item with an empty title
tests.description: Verifies that attempting to add an item without a title displays an alert and creates no item.

steps.action: Leave Item title blank and click 'Add item'

tests.title: Delete button removes only the selected item
tests.description: Verifies item removal specificity when multiple items are present in the list.

steps.action: Log in and create items 'First Task' and 'Second Task'

steps.expected: Removes only 'First Task' while 'Second Task' remains

tests.title: Settings page updates display name without console errors
tests.description: Verifies that saving user profile settings shows a success confirmation message.

steps.action: Update Display name to 'Alex Rivera' and click 'Save settings'

tests.title: Logout returns to login and browser back button prevents dashboard access
tests.description: Verifies session termination security and prevents accessing cached dashboard pages via browser history.

steps.expected: Returns the user to the login page
